title: Evaluating Nuanced Bias in Large Language Model Free Response Answers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating free-response answers to ambiguous and disambiguated contexts from the BBQ dataset by comparing counterfactual name-reversed pairs using automated filtering and human evaluation.
